newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P raises MMI CPA rating to 'A'.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P raises MMI CPA rating to 'A'.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Thursday said it has raised its claim-paying ability (CPA) rating on MMI General Insurance Ltd, the primary underwriting company of MMI Ltd, to 'A' from 'A-minus'.

S&P said the rating was based on MMI's improved capital and ownership structure, which affords good financial flexibility, solid business franchise featuring leadership position in the workers compensation market and improved earnings outlook.
"The upgrade relects a gradual improvement in MMI's business and financial profile over the past three years, coupled with an improved outlook," S&P said.
MMI is 17.6 percent owned by Allianz Versicherung AG. Allianz has indicated its intention to increase its stake to 37.6 percent, subject to shareholders approval.
